senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; זָכַר)memorial, remembrance, symbol, mnemonical allusion.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:12">Succ. III, 12</cite> <he>ז׳ למקדש</he> as a reminiscence of the Temple usages; <cite ref="Pesachim 115a:8">Pes. 115ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 116a:4">Ib. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ לתפוח</he> typical of the apple tree (<cite ref="Song of Songs 8:5">Cant. VIII, 5</cite>; v.
<cite ref="Sotah 11b">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite>); <he>ז׳ לטיט</he> typical of the clay (which the Israelites had to tread).

<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:8">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:8">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:4">VIII</cite>), 4, a. e. <he>אע״פ שאין … ז׳ לדבר</he> although there is no proof for it (in the Bible), there is a mnemonical allusion to it; a. fr.
